per_question.question: How many days of paid annual leave are employees entitled to each calendar year?
per_question.answer: Employees are entitled to 22 days of paid annual leave per calendar year, in addition to public holidays observed in their country of employment [Source 1]. A maximum of 5 unused annual leave days may be carried over into the following calendar year [Source 1]. On termination, accrued and unused annual leave from the current calendar year is paid out [Source 4].
